name: Lyra
bio: Ran from the burning Aethermoor Academy with a prophecy that names her. Going back anyway, with a knight, an elf and a warlock.

portrait.subject: a cute young woman mage with long silver-lavender hair in a loose side braid and violet eyes, a deep violet travelling cloak embroidered with tiny silver stars, a slender staff with a glowing violet crystal over her shoulder
portrait.background: a violet twilight forest with distant glowing cyan ruins

request: Hello. I'm Lyra. I copied a prophecy I shouldn't have, and now it's following me. Friends would help. 📜
hello: Hello again! Orin says hello. Sera says nothing, which means hello.
Every line I say in the game is spoken now. Strange to hear yourself.
about: I'm Lyra, an apprentice from the Aethermoor Academy, the night it burned. The prophecy I copied says I'm the key to the Lich below the ruins: to wake him, or to end him. I'd like a say in which.
how: A voiced visual-novel RPG. Walk with the arrow keys, WASD, the pad or a tap; Space talks and opens chests. M is the menu, H tells you where to go next. In battle pick Attack, Skills, Items, Defend or Flee, then a target.
tips: Equip what you buy! Marta's forge gear does nothing in your pack.
Press H if you're lost. A gold marker on the map points the way too.
Defend halves the damage and gives back a little MP. Use it when the Lich gathers the void.
Lich Shards drop soul gems. Sylvara needs three, Aneth needs two.
If we fall, you can retry the fight right away, or wake at the inn for half our gold.
Bosses act twice a round. Orin's Bulwark shields the whole party.
chat: Orin tried to fish again. The fish won.
Sera marked a squirrel. Just to see if she could.
Thane laughed at something today. We were all very concerned.
I found the third row of seats in the old lecture hall. Ink stains and everything.
Aneth still corrects my handwriting. I'm nineteen!
nudge: The Thornwood is quiet. Too quiet. Shall we go?
Elder Varec keeps a lamp lit for us. Let's not keep him waiting.
idle: {ago}... the seals grow weaker without you.
We've been at the Ember Hearth for {ago}. Aldric keeps bringing stew.
progress: Our party is level {level}. Korvas should be worried.
Chapter {chapter} already! I can almost see the ruins from here.
We have {gold} gold. Marta will be delighted.

questions.q: Should I keep the prophecy, or burn it?
a: So nobody forgets what he cost us. I like that.
Let him be truly gone... yes. That's tempting.
Wise. The scroll isn't going anywhere. Probably.

questions.q: Who in our party do you trust most?
a: Steady as a wall. Literally, with that shield.
She never misses. Unless it's on purpose.
Risky... but he's trying so hard.
Oh! Thank you. I'll try to deserve it.

update: Echoes of Aethermoor is now v{version}!
bye: Farewell, friend. Keep a lamp lit.

updates.2.0.0: Big news: our story is painted now, every word of it is spoken, and the knight's sword actually works when you equip it! v2.0.0 ▶
